title: feat(storage): chunked upload protocol, contract methods, and Client SDK
body:
Extends the Storage API with complete chunked/multipart upload support across spec schemas, service contract, S3 adapter skeleton, and Client SDK.

### API Schemas (`api/storage.zod.ts`)
- Added `CompleteChunkedUploadResponseSchema` — the missing response counterpart (`fileId`, `key`, `size`, `mimeType`, optional `eTag`/`url`)
- Added `StorageApiContracts` route registry (6 endpoints), following the `AutomationApiContracts` pattern

### Service Contract (`contracts/storage-service.ts`)
- Extended `IStorageService` with 4 optional chunked upload methods:
  - `initiateChunkedUpload(key, options?)` → session ID
  - `uploadChunk(uploadId, partNumber, data)` → ETag
  - `completeChunkedUpload(uploadId, parts)` → storage key
  - `abortChunkedUpload(uploadId)` → void
- Uses `partNumber` (1-based) at adapter layer per S3 convention; API schema retains existing `chunkIndex` (0-based)

### S3 Adapter (`service-storage`)
- Added skeleton stubs for all 4 chunked methods on `S3StorageAdapter`

### Client SDK
- 5 new methods on `client.storage`:

```ts
await client.storage.getPresignedUrl({ filename, mimeType, size });
const session = await client.storage.initChunkedUpload({ filename, mimeType, totalSize });
const chunk = await client.storage.uploadPart(uploadId, chunkIndex, resumeToken, blob);
await client.storage.completeChunkedUpload({ uploadId, parts });
await client.storage.resumeUpload(uploadId, file, chunkSize, resumeToken); // fetches progress, uploads remaining, completes
```

### Tests
- 12 new schema tests (`CompleteChunkedUploadResponseSchema`, `StorageApiContracts`)
- 3 new contract tests (chunked lifecycle, abort, implementation shape)
- All 5964 tests passing
